## Problem and evidence

Describe the concrete corpus, tokenizer, documentation, or reproducibility problem this change addresses.

## Change

Explain the smallest implemented change and why it belongs in this repository.

## Real validation

List the exact affected command or artifact check you ran and the observed result. Do not substitute synthetic data for an unavailable real source.

## Provenance and rights

- [ ] No corpus text, credentials, personal data, generated artifacts, or local machine paths are committed.
- [ ] Every new external source is pinned and recorded in `docs/SOURCE_REGISTRY.md` with its license.
- [ ] Relevant decisions, reports, model cards, and hashes are updated.
- [ ] The change does not silently modify the frozen tokenizer v2 checkpoint.
